notes.title: Game update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, the new game version has updated the following content

1. Newly added self-activity function, when the girlfriend is idle, she will carry out activities on her own
2. Newly added some self-activity actions
3. Newly added some game tips, in the chat interface
4. Reduce the consumption of girlfriend's satiety
5. Optimized some game content

notes.title: Multi-screen display is now supported!
notes.content:
8.31 Update the following

1. Support multiple monitors, you can move freely between the screens after opening, you can choose in the setting interface

2. Modify the original hidden button to a minimize button, which can be minimized to the task bar at the bottom of the screen, click the application icon in the task bar to restore

3. Optimized some game content

notes.title: Optimization update
notes.content:
8.25 update the following

1. Add a reminder whether the upload file in the creative workshop is successful
2. Lengthen the distance of the camera to prevent characters from penetrating the camera in the MOD
3. Optimized some game content

notes.title: Now supports MOD sound !
notes.content:
8.21 Update the following

1. Added support for MOD sound
2. Update the MOD sound tutorial
3. Added music to the dance in the Mod folder
4. Use double-sided rendering for clothes material
5. Optimized some game content

notes.title: Optimization update
notes.content:
2020.8.14 update the following

1. Newly added changes in character expressions in MOD

2. Optimized part of the game content

notes.title: New features launched !
notes.content:
Hello everyone, the new game version has updated the following content

1.Specific scenes can change the animation speed of characters

2.Newly added Five Chess gameplay

3.Optimized some game content

I wish you a happy game!

notes.title: English version update
notes.content: Hello everyone, Now the game adds support for English, Can be selected in the first launch of the game, I wish you a happy game !

notes.title: Optimization update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this update has optimized Chinese Chess

1. Fixed a few cases where it may not be clickable
2. Newly added Chinese chess difficulty mode, which can be selected in the setting interface

I wish you a happy game !

notes.title: Game update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, the following content has been added in the new version

1.Added more game sound effects
2.Time pause function, time will not automatically increase after opening
3.Weather effect can be set to display
4.The position and rotation function of the character can be restored

I wish you a happy game !
